_note: The Nile tilapia's life (the animal life kit, docs/plans/animal-life-cycle.md, step 2: breeding on, 2026-11-19; all numbers my picks, fun first). Sizes are shares of its usual size (0.6 blocks grown); days are game days. A ready male fans a nest pit out of a shallow bed and holds it; a ready female comes to him, they circle over the pit for 6 seconds and she takes 4 to 6 eggs into her mouth for a day; the fry (0.13 blocks) stay round her face for 2 days, darting back into her mouth from danger, then school as young fish and are grown 5 days after hatching. The world's own young spawns are 2 to 3 days old (as big as before step 2). Breeds only while fewer than 40 tilapia live within 48 blocks and the river fish group is under its cap.
